# [Matt Baume](https://www.mattbaume.com/)

[Matt Baume](https://www.mattbaume.com/s/nate-pic-rainbow.jpg) _Matt Baume/photo by Nate Gowdy  
_ [_Click for larger version._](https://www.mattbaume.com/s/nate-pic-rainbow.jpg)

Matt Baume is a writer, podcaster, and video-maker based in Seattle whose work focuses on pop culture and queer history.

His latest book, [_Hi Honey, I'm Homo!_](https://www.mattbaume.com/hi-honey-im-homo) , traces the evolution of LGBTQ+ characters on American sitcoms. His previous book, [_Defining Marriage_](https://www.mattbaume.com/defining-marriage-cover-page) , chronicles the personal stories of people who fought for marriage equality over the last forty years.

In his popular YouTube series, Matt shares behind-the-scenes stories about the movies and TV shows that changed the world, and the fascinating people involved. He's also the creator of the podcast [_The Sewers of Paris_](https://www.mattbaume.com/the-sewers-of-paris) , which explores the entertainment that has shaped the lives of queer people.
